row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote based on apps, IPs, web apps and user licences)
row.evidence: Qualys documents no SCIM endpoint; instead its Azure AD/Entra ID Sync connector synchronises users and roles from Azure AD on an hourly schedule, automatically creating, updating and deactivating Qualys users.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Qualys pricing depends on the Cloud Platform apps, number of IPs, web applications and user licences ('Want a quote or have questions?'). No SCIM endpoint is documented in the Administration help or the Qualys API (VM, PC) user guide. User lifecycle automation is a vendor-run Microsoft Entra ID Directory Sync connector (Connectors app; group-to-role mapping; hourly sync that creates, updates and deactivates users; users then sign in via SAML SSO with a qualysguard_external_id claim). It needs the RBAC unified user management, which the Administration help still calls a Beta feature enabled through the TAM. The legacy XML API (/msp/user.php, /msp/user_list.php) lets Managers add, edit, list, activate and deactivate users; all user roles except Contact can use the API. Okta OIN 'Qualys Guard' app is SAML/SWA only; no Entra gallery app found.

plans.name: Qualys Cloud Platform subscription (Enterprise, SMB, Government)
plans.notes: Price depends on selected apps, IP count, web applications and user licences. Express Lite subscriptions can use the user API (max 3 users).

scim.notes: available=false by absence: no SCIM in the Administration help or the API guide; the documented IdP integration is a vendor-run Entra ID directory sync connector (see fallbacks.other_sync).

auth.notes: Basic or session auth with a Qualys user account; IdP-based API authentication can be enabled by Qualys Support. Permissions follow the caller's user role.

capabilities.notes: user.php add takes user_role; activate/deactivate keeps account settings. No delete action is documented in this guide.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the subscription (GET or POST)
Activate or deactivate a user (GET or POST)

rate_limits.text: Per-subscription concurrency limit and rate limit per API (1-hour or 1-day window), set by service level and customisable by Qualys Support.

limitations.text: Activate/deactivate does not support session-based authentication; accounts in Pending Activation cannot be activated or deactivated.

okta.notes: OIN 'Qualys Guard' app ticks SAML and SWA only (last updated Jan. 29 2020).

entra.notes: Vendor-run Microsoft Entra ID Directory Sync connector plus a SAML enterprise app configured per Qualys's guide; no Entra gallery tutorial found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Directory Sync connector: hourly sync of group members, create/update/deactivate users, AD group to Qualys role mapping

Whether the user API is included in every subscription or limited by service level is not stated; no user delete endpoint was found in the VM/PC API guide.
